gbm_population_evidence.quote: Cohort Phase IID: Any recurrent glioblastoma without MYC or MYCN amplifications.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] PLX038: PLX038 is given intravenously (IV) at the assigned dose level over about 1 hour on day 1 of each 21-day cycle

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Cohort Phase IIA: Newly diagnosed MYCN amplified ependymoma after surgery and radiation.
Cohort Phase IID: Any recurrent glioblastoma without MYC or MYCN amplifications.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: PLX038 drug distribution will be investigated in peripheral blood and tumor tissue post-treatment administration.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Molecular biomarkers of treatment response or resistance will be investigated in an exploratory manner pre and post-treatment (after cycle 2 and after tumor progression) in tumor tissue, hair follicles, and peripheral blood.

agents.drug_class_hint: PEGylated SN-38 (active metabolite of irinotecan) topoisomerase 1 inhibitor
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: SN38 binds to and inhibits topoisomerase 1

source_quote.quote: Cohort Phase IIC: Any other recurrent or progressive primary CNS tumor with MYC or MYCN amplifications.

flag.reason: Link between MYC/MYCN amplification and a TOP1 inhibitor rests on the stated rationale (MYC-driven topoisomerase complexes), not a standard matched pair; could change the primary outcome

coder_notes: Basket-like CNS tumour trial (glioma, medulloblastoma, ependymoma, glioblastoma named in conditions); coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Cohorts IIA-IIC require MYC/MYCN amplification; cohort IID (recurrent GBM) requires absence of amplification, so MYC status is not required for GBM. A second unnamed drug (infection prophylaxis, self-injected) is mentioned in the summary only and not listed. Setting: IIA newly diagnosed ependymoma, other cohorts recurrent/progressive. Registered arms are Phase I and Phase II, not cohorts.
